{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA condemns the Georgia law outlawing abortion after six weeks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Georgia law outlaws abortion earlier than most people realize they are pregnant.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Georgia law does not include exceptions for rape or incest.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA anticipates legal challenges will likely delay the Georgia law's implementation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Georgia law expands the definition of “natural persons” to include embryos and fetuses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"People who get abortions in Georgia and their doctors could face criminal prosecution and a sentence of life in prison if the law takes effect.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"People who miscarry in Georgia may be interrogated for proof it was not intentional if the law takes effect.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"People who travel out of state for abortion and those who help them will risk charges of criminal conspiracy if the law takes effect.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A pending Alabama bill would make performing an abortion a felony punishable by up to 99 years imprisonment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A pending Ohio bill would ban almost all effective methods of birth control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The pending Ohio bill invents a bizarre new medical procedure.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"If attempted, the new medical procedure proposed in the Ohio bill would likely lead to significantly more maternal deaths.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Groups like the ACLU respond to new restrictions with lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Lawsuits can buy time, but also play into the hands of the far-right.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The far-right seeks to overturn Roe vs Wade.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
